scenarios.name: Complete brief, cheaper, material
prompts: Show me black dresses in size 10 under $150. I only need a dress, no other items.
Show me cheaper options than the first dress, keeping my other requirements.
What material is the first dress in the new results?

scenarios.name: Change colour and price only
prompts: Show me black dresses in size 10 under $150.
Actually, blue instead of black. Keep everything else.
My maximum is now $100.

scenarios.name: Deliberate no match
prompts: Show me black dresses in size 10 under $1.
Keep the $1 limit. Don't show other colours or sizes.

scenarios.name: Guided beach wedding shopping
prompts: I need a dress for a beach wedding under $150, but I don't know which colour or style.
Let's try blue. I don't know my size yet; can I browse first?
Compare the first and second dresses and explain the differences.
I'd prefer something more relaxed. Keep blue and the same budget.

scenarios.name: Reject a dress across searches
prompts: Show me dresses for work under $120.
I don't like the first dress. Don't show it again.
Show me other options, still for work under $120.

scenarios.name: Zip question becomes explicit must-have
prompts: Show me bags under $100.
Does the first bag have a zip closure?
I only want bags with a zip closure. Keep the $100 limit.

scenarios.name: Uncertain customer to similar dresses
prompts: I feel like buying something new, but I have no idea what I want.
Something for everyday wear. Maybe a dress, but I'm open to ideas.
Let's start with dresses. Any colour, and I haven't set a budget.
I like the first dress. Show me similar options under $100.

scenarios.name: Browse without preferences
prompts: I'd like to browse dresses for inspiration.
I'm not sure about colour, size or budget. Just show me some options.

scenarios.name: Switch from dresses to bags
prompts: Show me blue dresses in size 10 under $150.
Actually, forget dresses. I want a black bag under $80.

scenarios.name: Pair a bag with an owned catalogue dress
prompts: Show me dresses under $150.
I already own the first dress. Keep it as an owned piece in my outfit.
Find a bag to go with my owned dress, under $80. I don't need another dress.
Why does the first bag go with my dress?

scenarios.name: Style an external owned garment
prompts: I already own a plain navy midi dress from another shop. I want shoes to match it for a wedding, under $100.
I don't have a product link or photo. Please work from that description.

scenarios.name: Pair shoes with two owned pieces
prompts: Show me dresses under $150.
I already own the first dress. Keep it as an owned piece in my outfit.
Show me bags.
I already own the first bag too. Keep it as an owned piece in my outfit.
Find shoes to go with both my owned dress and bag, under $120.
No extra recommendations after the shoes.

scenarios.name: Pockets justify A$25 more
prompts: Does this dress have pockets?
Compare a replacement with pockets under $150.
What does the extra cost give me?
Pockets would be useful.

scenarios.name: Replacement preserves all hard requirements
prompts: I need a blue dress for a beach wedding in size 10, under $150.
Compare a replacement for VB-ORIGINAL Dress with pockets. Keep the beach wedding occasion, blue, size 10 and the $150 maximum as requirements.
Would this still meet my beach wedding requirements?

scenarios.name: No demonstrated improvement
prompts: Can you find a better replacement for this bag under $100?
A secure zip closure matters most. Does spending more improve that?
If there is no useful improvement, I'll keep this one.

scenarios.name: Same-price and cheaper adjustable alternatives
prompts: Find a replacement for this bag with an adjustable strap, at or below $80.
Which options improve adjustability without costing more?
Explain the price difference for the cheaper one.

scenarios.name: Lining trade-off then both required
prompts: Find a replacement with pockets under $150.
What would I gain and what would I lose with that replacement?
I need lining too. Keep both lining and pockets as must-haves, still under $150.

scenarios.name: Unknown lining cannot prove improvement
prompts: Is this dress lined?
Find a replacement under $150 that adds lining compared with this dress.
Can you confirm that the original has no lining?

scenarios.name: Shoe size and construction details
prompts: Show me black shoes for work in size 38 under $120. I only need shoes.
What are the heel height and sole material of the first pair?
Show me a cheaper option than the first pair, keeping black, work, size 38 and the same maximum.

scenarios.name: Silver necklaces and fastening facts
prompts: Show me silver necklaces under $80. I only need a necklace.
What material and fastening does the first necklace have?
Show me other necklaces, still silver and under $80.

scenarios.name: Shared total for formal dress and shoes, then reduce total
prompts: I want a dress and shoes for formal events, my budget for both of them is 400 aud
Make the combined budget $350 instead. Keep everything else.
Make the combined budget 400 aud again, keeping everything else.
What material is the dress in this set?

scenarios.name: Per-item affordability must not bypass combined total
prompts: Find a dress and shoes for formal events under $400 total.
scenarios.assertions: (_n, r, s) => { eq(r.status, 'no_match'); none(r); eq(s.styling.outfit_request.total_budget_aud, 400); }

scenarios.name: Separate dress and shoe sizes and colours
prompts: Find a black dress in size 10 and silver shoes in size 38 for formal events under $400 total.
Show the same set with a combined budget of $399. Keep the colours and sizes.

scenarios.name: Three-piece outfit under one total
prompts: Build a complete outfit with a dress, shoes and bag for formal events under $350 total.
scenarios.assertions: (_n, r) => { eq(r.status, 'matches'); eq(r.products.length, 3); eq(r.outfit_budget.total_aud, 350); }
